text: The yacht Seren Aduial was captained by Lucas Wetherby during the Pallister Cup, according to the event’s official results bulletin and a subsequent confirmation from the Pallister Regatta Office. The bulletin, released late Sunday, listed Wetherby as skipper of the 18-metre cutter in the final fleet standings after the three-day race off Marrow Point. In a brief statement, race secretary Elin Vance said the crew “sailed under Captain Wetherby throughout the competition,” and noted the vessel placed fourth overall with a corrected time of 14 hours, 22 minutes and 11 seconds. The regatta’s logbook also records Wetherby signing in as master before the opening leg on 14 June.
